analysisPlan: Verify the frozen SHA-256 checksums for the development targets and pose ledger before analysis.
Join each development target to the SHA-pinned public numbering differential by PDB identifier, receptor:VHH chain pair, and VHH sequence SHA-256.
Require identical legacy-versus-candidate numbering status, query bounds, CDR lengths, and complete seven-region assignments for every development target.
Use the fact that each development pose is produced only by a rigid-body coordinate transform: sequence identity, residue order, and IMGT assignment are invariant under the transform.
Infer pose-level CDR-contact-share and CDR3-contact-share equality only after the complete per-target region-assignment equality checks pass.
Read the already-observed DockQ/CAPRI labels only after the equality inference, and use them solely to report stratified counts rather than to define or tune the candidate.
prespecifiedOutputs: counts stratified by CAPRI class and target
